page_template: Place the tile at 1:1 scale on a sheet supported by the actual machine, then trim if needed. Do not assume a 100 mm card can be fed directly.
review: A source change or process change requires fresh proof hashes, individual visual inspection, device-output inspection and touch review.
source_concepts: Keep stable edu./aac. concept IDs and meaning-specific category paths. Collage geometry is reference material, not proof of process compatibility.
semantic_encoding: Black raised footprint on a white unraised field. No gray-to-height assumption.
fill_strategy: Test the filled-shape footprint on the selected paper. If large solid areas swell unevenly, evaluate a uniform textured interior preserving the full shape extent; do not silently substitute an outline for a filled-shape lesson.
controls: Paper brand/batch, compatible carbon-based ink or toner and printer path
Fuser model, temperature setting, warm-up and number of passes
Developed line width, gap retention, raised area evenness, paper curl
limitations: Trial dimensions are project experiments, not BANA-certified values. Keep very fine lines and large solid black areas on separate initial test sheets.
